name: Lucent Launcher
description:
A keyboard launcher on a sheet of glass: apps, windows, files, a calculator, unit and currency conversion, system toggles, timers, definitions, web shortcuts and your own commands, ranked by what you actually pick.

What it touches, so there are no surprises: it keeps a clipboard history (in memory unless you switch on saving) and can paste from it; it runs the commands you type after '>'; and it contacts the network only for a currency rate table from the ECB, for word definitions, and, if you switch it on, for search suggestions. Each of these can be turned off in the preferences.
